data.r_code: mrf_export(frame = dat, score = dat$pd_rf, decision = NULL)
data.explanation: I chose 'dat' as the frame since it contains all the raw input features used by the model, along with the predicted probabilities stored in 'pd_rf'. The score is directly taken from 'dat$pd_rf', which represents the model's output for each record. No training rows are specified because the model was fitted on all available rows in 'dat'.
